name: ${NAME}
description: Sigil-ZS zero-shot (P5-B) on ${EP}: the slot in ${SLOT_ZS} (manifest format sigil-zs-1, family options e.g. {"preset": "sigil_low"}) converting toward the reference clip ${REFERENCE} (a library voice can be named with engine.reference_voice instead). The family runs its own fixed 100 ms (180 ms for upstream_readme) blocks and plays with at least the Stable output buffer (80 ms prefill, 150 ms queue; the family's minimum, applied by the voice changer and by paced runs). Offline compute, a wall-clock paced run (T10 idle), the H2 load simulator and the H1 simulation (T10 under load), and fidelity against the offline ceiling (the voice's one-off conversion of the recorded stream; P5-I0). Needs the vc/zs-seed-vc model-store entry in the app data (Models tab Import, or SIGIL_LOCAL_ASSETS = the export folder). Materialized by run-perf-gate.ps1 -Profile p5.
